_comment: What the unattended pass scans. scope: 'board' = every liquid book on the exchange (the same top-N the News view sweeps), plus the symbols listed here; 'watchlist' = only the symbols; 'app' = the app's built-in list. exclude: never scanned whatever the scope - Bybit lists tokenised stocks, ETFs and metals as perpetuals and they are not coins. always: read on a clock every pass whether or not anything crossed the gate, outside the budget - the dedicated Bitcoin page lives on this. Overridden by ODYSSEUS_WATCHLIST (a scope word, or comma-separated symbols). Read on every call - no restart needed.
